propositions: A declared-none file-impact ticket retains its signed certification after unrelated commits move HEAD, without re-hashing whole-HEAD drift
Empty dependency paths with explicit own-scope none classify as none and skip whole-HEAD freshness check, while unscoped or undeclared empty sets fall back to stale-head behavior
The manifest contract emits an authenticated file-scope: none declaration only for classified none scope; paths and unscoped output remain byte-identical to pre-feature serialization
A none-scope declaration present only in unauthenticated plaintext cannot suppress stale-head validity; only authenticated manifest declarations are recognized
Changing file_impact_scope from none to paths, or editing no_file_impact_reason for a none-scoped record, produces stale-material due to canonical fingerprint basis addition

resign_plan_review recovery operation preserves none scope through the same signing boundary without new branches, and legacy manifests lacking file-scope declarations retain unscoped validity semantics
